company.shortDescription: Pickle develops AI avatar software that creates digital clones with synchronized voice and video generation for virtual meetings and calls.
company.description: Pickle develops AI-powered avatar software designed for virtual meetings and online communication. The platform creates digital clones that lip-sync to a user’s voice using synchronized voice and video generation models. Its technology helps users join video calls without a physical camera, maintain a professional appearance, reduce preparation time, and communicate efficiently while multitasking remotely.
